en.basel-kadem: 6.	With this chain of narrators, from Hussain bin Sa’eed, from Fadala, from Aban, from Abu’l-Jaroud, from one of the two, peace be upon them both,

with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And by the witness, and by what is to be witnessed» [85:3]. He said: The witness is Friday, that which is to be witnessed is the Day of Arafah and that which is promised is the Day of Resurrection.
